provenance.notes: GUI worker, real XTest pointer/keys, warp-handshake relative increments of 4 px; per-increment offsets from the editor's own command journal (no editor query while a button is held); state reads between gestures; residual cells (*_no_read, live_undo_walk_two_presses): no scripting call between gestures, history read from the undo-list frames, one read at the end; residual-4 cells: activation by the tool's key, mid-session counts through the read-only query verb; residual-5 cells: a value typed into the tool panel through real keys, read back through the read-only query verb; residual-6 cells: shift-modified and middle-button presses through real input; residual-7 cells: Ctrl+Z walk after a shift or middle press, tool state from a read that opens no command block

rig.view: orthographic top (view axis +Y; screen right = +X, screen up = -Z)
rig.offset_quantum_note: every written offset component is a multiple of 0.005 (4 px = 0.0105 -> 0.01, 6 incr -> 0.065)

axis_arm_drag_world.input: engage with a 3-increment screen-up drag on empty space, release, press the Z arm, 10 increments of (+4,-4) px (DIAGONAL), release
axis_arm_drag_world.law: the arm writes ONLY its own component from the first increment (off-arm components stay exactly as they were); monotone; first step = one increment

axis_arm_drag_selection_axis.input: as axis_arm_drag_world with the selection axis stage armed

arm_press_after_motionless_click_is_a_ne.input: a motionless click on empty space, then press where the Z arm was drawn, diagonal 10 x (+4,-4) px
arm_press_after_motionless_click_is_a_ne.law: a motionless click commits and leaves no grabbable arm; the next press starts a NEW extend and drags in the screen plane
arm_press_after_motionless_click_is_a_ne.superseded_by: arm_press_after_motionless_click_no_read: this cell read the editor through the scripting door between the click and the press, which ends the session; without it the arm is grabbed in the same run

symmetry_plus_side_arm.input: symmetry X on, +X ridge selected, X arm 10 x (+4,+4) px (after the 3-increment screen-up engage drag)

symmetry_minus_side_arm.input: symmetry X on, -X ridge selected, X arm 10 x (+4,+4) px (after the 3-increment screen-up engage drag)

symmetry_both_sides_arm.input: symmetry X on, both ridges selected, X arm 10 x (+4,+4) px (after the 3-increment screen-up engage drag)

symmetry_plus_side_haul.input: symmetry X on, +X ridge, drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,0) px

symmetry_minus_side_haul.input: symmetry X on, -X ridge, drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,0) px

no_symmetry_haul_control.input: symmetry OFF, +X ridge, drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,0) px

cells.symmetry_law: no mirrored copy is created; an element with x>0 receives (-ox, oy, oz), an element with x<0 receives (ox, oy, oz), an element with x==0 receives (0, oy, oz); the drawn arm follows +o

switch_key_after_release.input: after the X-arm drag is released, tap the scale-tool key
switch_key_after_release.undo_after_switch: one undo restores the extend tool with its offset and the geometry; the next removes the extension (ignoring read-induced entries, see README)
switch_key_after_release.law: the key switches to the scale transform; the extension is kept (committed)
switch_key_after_release.superseded_undo_walk: switch_key_undo_walk_no_read: the key/extension law stands; the undo walk here contained entries added by state reads, the read-free walk is 3 steps (switch group, whole run, arming)

switch_key_while_button_held.input: X arm: 5 increments, tap the scale-tool key with the button held, 5 more, release
switch_key_while_button_held.law: the key is ignored: no switch is issued at all, the drag continues to 10 increments, extend stays active

rearm_after_arm_drag.input: d1 = 10 x (+4,+4) arm drag (or 10 x (+4,0) haul), release; (a) motionless click on empty space; (b) 5 x (+4,0) drag on empty space
rearm_after_arm_drag.law: every press on empty space commits the current extend and starts a NEW one at offset 0: (a) adds a zero-length ring (3 coincident vertices, 2 zero-area quads), (b) adds a ring offset by d2 from the previous one
rearm_after_arm_drag.instrument_note: rearm_after_arm_drag / rearm_after_haul (new activation per press) were recorded with a state read between the gestures, which ends the session; they describe that instrument, not a bare re-press

rearm_after_haul.input: d1 = 10 x (+4,+4) arm drag (or 10 x (+4,0) haul), release; (a) motionless click on empty space; (b) 5 x (+4,0) drag on empty space
rearm_after_haul.law: every press on empty space commits the current extend and starts a NEW one at offset 0: (a) adds a zero-length ring (3 coincident vertices, 2 zero-area quads), (b) adds a ring offset by d2 from the previous one
rearm_after_haul.instrument_note: rearm_after_arm_drag / rearm_after_haul (new activation per press) were recorded with a state read between the gestures, which ends the session; they describe that instrument, not a bare re-press

symmetry_on_plane_vertex.input: symmetry X on, edge (0,1,0)-(1,1,0) selected (one end ON the plane); drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px (diagonal), release

symmetry_on_plane_chain.input: symmetry X on, chain (-1,1,0)-(0,1,0)-(1,1,0) selected (crosses the plane at its middle vertex); drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px (diagonal), release

symmetry_near_plane_plus.input: as symmetry_on_plane_vertex with the on-plane vertex moved to x = +1e-4; drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px (diagonal), release

symmetry_near_plane_minus.input: as symmetry_on_plane_vertex with the on-plane vertex moved to x = -1e-4; drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px (diagonal), release

on_plane_vertex_no_symmetry_control.input: symmetry OFF, edge (0,1,0)-(1,1,0) selected; drag on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px (diagonal), release

cells.symmetry_on_plane_law: a source vertex with x == 0 exactly receives (0, oy, oz): its X offset is ZEROED, it stays on the plane and is extruded once, welded to nothing; the sign test is strict -- x = +1e-4 already receives -ox and x = -1e-4 receives +ox (no tolerance band at 1e-4)

symmetric_click_selection.view: front orthographic (the plane faces the camera), pixel size 0.0031056 m
symmetric_click_selection.input: symmetry X on, edge mode, nothing selected, no tool; one motionless click on the midpoint of the +X ridge edge (7,8); then the extend tool armed and a haul on EMPTY space 10 x (+4,+4) px
symmetric_click_selection.law_selection: the click selects the clicked edge AND its mirror (7,8)+(2,1)
symmetric_click_selection.law_press_side: the side of the ACTIVATING press decides which side receives +o: press at x > 0 -> x>0 elements get (+ox, oy, oz) and x<0 elements (-ox, oy, oz) (outward here); press at x < 0 -> the reverse (inward here, = the both-sides arm cell). Every earlier symmetry cell activated with a press at the view-centre column x ~ 0 and follows the x<0-press branch

symmetry_second_press_side.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; symmetry X; (7,8) clicked -> (7,8)+(2,1) selected; extend armed; NO state read between the gestures unless the cell says so
symmetry_second_press_side.input: two hauls on EMPTY space, each 10 x (+4,+4) px, released in between; press world xy given per cell

plus_then_minus.undo_walk_note: this walk ran after the final state read had ended the session (a committed run); the live walk is live_undo_walk_two_presses

plus_then_minus_state_read_between.note: a state read through the editor's scripting door between the hauls ENDS the tool session; the second press is then a new activation extending from the first ring

symmetry_second_press_side.law: with no intervening state read a second off-handle press CONTINUES the run (no new activation, the offset accumulates, one ring) and a motionless click in between is absorbed; the sign side is RE-LATCHED at every off-handle press: the whole ring takes the side of the LATEST press (plus_then_minus +X ridge 1 - 0.25 = 0.75; minus_then_plus 1 + 0.25 = 1.25; latching at the first press would give the opposite in both)
symmetry_second_press_side.supersedes_note: rearm_after_arm_drag / rearm_after_haul (new activation per press) were recorded with a state read between the gestures, which ends the session; they describe that instrument, not a bare re-press

symmetry_handle_press_side.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; symmetry X; (7,8) clicked -> (7,8)+(2,1) selected; extend armed; NO state read between the gestures unless the cell says so
symmetry_handle_press_side.input: engage haul on EMPTY space (press world xy given), release; then press ON the Y (green) arm of the drawn handle and drag 10 x (+4,+4) px (the Y arm freezes the X offset: proof of grab)
symmetry_handle_press_side.handle_position: the move handle is drawn at the clicked edge's bounding-box middle (1, 0.5) plus the raw offset, whichever side the ring went

blind_first_press_where_the_arm_would_be.note: after arming no handle is drawn at all (8 frames, 0 arm pixels); a first press where the X arm lies after a haul is an ordinary haul (offset Y moved), +X master

symmetry_handle_press_side.law: a press ON the handle keeps the side latched by the last off-handle press; neither the handle centre's side nor the press pixel's side enters (gizmo_plus_side: +X ridge 0.875 = 1 - 0.125, re-latch would give 1.125; gizmo_minus_side: +X ridge -0.365 = 1 - 1.365, re-latch would give 2.365). The first press of a session can never be a handle press: no handle exists before it

arm_press_after_motionless_click_no_read.view: top orthographic, 0.0026224 m/px; (6,7)+(7,8) selected; no symmetry
arm_press_after_motionless_click_no_read.input: arm; a motionless click on empty space; press ON the Z (blue) arm drawn in the frame taken right after the click; diagonal 10 x (+4,-4) px; NO scripting call between the click and the drag
arm_press_after_motionless_click_no_read.law: after a motionless click the arm IS drawn and grabbable: the press continues the same run (no new activation), the off-arm components stay exactly 0 on every increment (a screen haul would have written offX +0.105), and the click leaves no zero-length ring (one new ring)

switch_key_undo_walk_no_read.input: engage haul 3 x (0,-4) on empty space, release; X-arm drag 10 x (+4,+4), release; tap the scale-tool key at once; then Ctrl+Z x4; NO scripting call anywhere before the final read

undo_walk.pops: the three switch rows as one step
vertex-map row + both gesture rows + post-mode apply (the whole run, both gestures)

switch_key_undo_walk_no_read.law: the key switches to the scale transform and keeps the extension; after a switch the extend run is ONE undo step (both gestures together); the first Ctrl+Z returns Extend with its offset and geometry, the second removes the whole extension, the third ends the tool
switch_key_undo_walk_no_read.arming_step_note: the third step popping the arming is an artefact of arming through the scripting door, whose command block is its own undo step; with the activation key the arming is popped by step 2 together with the run (activation_history_rows)

live_undo_walk_two_presses.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; symmetry X; (7,8) clicked -> (7,8)+(2,1) selected; extend armed
live_undo_walk_two_presses.input: haul at world (0.5,1.35) then at (-0.5,1.35), each 10 x (+4,+4) px, one run; then Ctrl+Z x3 with NO scripting call; ridges from the frames

undo_walk.pops: vertex-map row + first gesture row + post-mode apply

live_undo_walk_two_presses.law: Ctrl+Z on a LIVE extend pops the newest gesture only (not the run); the offset reverts to the first press's value but the sign side stays latched by the popped press: ridges +-0.875, a state never shown live (after the first press alone they were +-1.125); the next Ctrl+Z removes the rest of the run, the third ends the tool
live_undo_walk_two_presses.arming_step_note: the third step popping the arming is an artefact of arming through the scripting door, whose command block is its own undo step; with the activation key the arming is popped by step 2 together with the run (activation_history_rows)

symmetry_side_flip_motionless_click.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); symmetry X (the click selects the mirror edge too); tool armed before any gesture
symmetry_side_flip_motionless_click.input: haul at world (0.5, 1.35), 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then ONE motionless click at world (-0.5, 1.35); no scripting call between gestures
symmetry_side_flip_motionless_click.law: a motionless press on the other side re-latches the sign side at the PRESS: the geometry flips from +-1.125 to +-0.875 with the offset unchanged (the press re-applies the same offset), and a release without motion keeps the flip

symmetry_side_flip_press_then_drag.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); symmetry X; tool armed before any gesture
symmetry_side_flip_press_then_drag.input: haul at world (0.5, 1.35), 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; press at world (-0.5, 1.35), hold 1 s, then 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call between gestures
symmetry_side_flip_press_then_drag.law: the side flips on the press frame, before any motion (+-0.875 while held); the drag then continues the same run from the carried offset (0.125 -> 0.25)

first_activation_by_key_drag_no_symmetry.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
first_activation_by_key_drag_no_symmetry.input: tap the tool's shipped activation key with the pointer in the viewport; frames 0.2/0.6/1.5 s later; press on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35), hold 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px
first_activation_by_key_drag_no_symmetry.law: the key arms the tool without drawing a handle and without starting the operation; the first press starts it (zero offset written, a zero-length ring created in place, the handle appears); the first increment writes one increment's worth (0.01 for 0.0124 m of pointer travel, quantised to 0.005) -- no jump

first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.input: tap the activation key; one motionless click on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35); counts through the read-only query verb while the run is live; then the drop key
first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.law: a motionless first click starts the operation with a zero offset: it adds a zero-length ring (new vertices coincident with the source edge ends, one zero-area polygon per edge) and draws the handle, but moves nothing

first_activation_by_key_drag_symmetry.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); symmetry X (the click selects the mirror edge too)
first_activation_by_key_drag_symmetry.input: tap the tool's shipped activation key with the pointer in the viewport; frames 0.2/0.6/1.5 s later; press on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35), hold 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px
first_activation_by_key_drag_symmetry.law: the key arms the tool without drawing a handle and without starting the operation; the first press starts it (zero offset written, a zero-length ring created in place, the handle appears); the first increment writes one increment's worth (0.01 for 0.0124 m of pointer travel, quantised to 0.005) -- no jump

first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); symmetry X (the click selects the mirror edge too)
first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.input: tap the activation key; one motionless click on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35); counts through the read-only query verb while the run is live; then the drop key
first_activation_by_key_motionless_click.law: a motionless first click starts the operation with a zero offset: it adds a zero-length ring (new vertices coincident with the source edge ends, one zero-area polygon per edge) and draws the handle, but moves nothing

activation_history_rows.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry; undo-list palette open before the key
activation_history_rows.input: tap the activation key; haul at world (0.5, 1.35) then at (-0.5, 1.35), each 10 x (+4,+4) px; (switch variant: then the scale-tool key); Ctrl+Z x3; no scripting call after the scene build
activation_history_rows.law: the activation key writes ONE history row at once, but it is not a separate undo step: it is undone together with the run's first gesture group. Live: #1 pops the newest gesture, #2 pops the rest of the run AND the activation (the tool ends), #3 undoes the command before the tool. After a tool switch: #1 the switch group, #2 the whole run with the activation, #3 the command before

first_press_after_typed_offset_motionles.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
first_press_after_typed_offset_motionles.typed: after the activation key, Offset X typed into the tool panel as 300 mm (Return); the other two components held non-zero values carried over from the previous session
first_press_after_typed_offset_motionles.input: activation key; type the offset; one motionless click on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35); counts and offsets through the read-only query verb
first_press_after_typed_offset_motionles.law: typing the offset before the first press only sets the value (no operation, 9 vertices); the first press starts the operation by writing a ZERO offset on all three components, discarding the typed value: a zero-length ring at the source edge ends

first_press_after_typed_offset_drag.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
first_press_after_typed_offset_drag.typed: after the activation key, Offset X typed into the tool panel as 300 mm (Return); the other two components held non-zero values carried over from the previous session
first_press_after_typed_offset_drag.input: activation key; type the offset; press on empty space at world (0.5, 1.35), hold 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px
first_press_after_typed_offset_drag.law: the drag after a typed offset starts from zero, not from the typed value: the first increment writes one increment's worth (0.01), the tenth 0.125

switch_undo_restore_then_haul.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry; undo-list palette open before the key
switch_undo_restore_then_haul.input: activation key; haul at world (0.5, 1.35) then at (-0.5, 1.35), each 10 x (+4,+4) px; the scale-tool key; ONE Ctrl+Z; haul at (0.5, 1.35), 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call after the scene build
switch_undo_restore_then_haul.law: one Ctrl+Z after a tool switch returns the extend tool armed, showing the run's offset (0.25), but the run is NOT live: its apply stays committed. The next press logs no new activation row, yet it writes offset 0 and extrudes a NEW ring from the committed one (ridge 1.25 -> 1.375, 11 -> 13 vertices); the restored offset is neither continued nor carried

shift_press_after_haul_motionless.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
shift_press_after_haul_motionless.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then one motionless Shift+left click at world (0.5, 1.35); no scripting call after the scene build
shift_press_after_haul_motionless.law: the shift press applies the finished run (its ring stays) and starts a NEW operation from offset 0 on all components: a motionless shift click leaves a zero-length ring on the committed ridge (+2 vertices, +1 polygon per edge, nothing moves); a shift drag grows the new ring from 0 (first increment 0.01)

shift_press_after_haul_drag.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
shift_press_after_haul_drag.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then Shift+left press at world (0.5, 1.35), held 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call after the scene build
shift_press_after_haul_drag.law: the shift press applies the finished run (its ring stays) and starts a NEW operation from offset 0 on all components: a motionless shift click leaves a zero-length ring on the committed ridge (+2 vertices, +1 polygon per edge, nothing moves); a shift drag grows the new ring from 0 (first increment 0.01)

middle_press_after_haul_motionless.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
middle_press_after_haul_motionless.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then one motionless middle click at world (0.5, 1.35); no scripting call after the scene build
middle_press_after_haul_motionless.law: the middle press applies the finished run and starts a NEW operation that immediately re-applies the previous offset: a motionless middle click already extrudes a second ring displaced by the previous offset (ridge 1.125 -> 1.25); a middle drag continues from the previous offset (first increment 0.135, tenth 0.25)

middle_press_after_haul_drag.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
middle_press_after_haul_drag.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then middle press at world (0.5, 1.35), held 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call after the scene build
middle_press_after_haul_drag.law: the middle press applies the finished run and starts a NEW operation that immediately re-applies the previous offset: a motionless middle click already extrudes a second ring displaced by the previous offset (ridge 1.125 -> 1.25); a middle drag continues from the previous offset (first increment 0.135, tenth 0.25)

shift_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_si.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); mirror symmetry across x = 0 (the click selected both ridges)
shift_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_si.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then Shift+left press at world (-0.5, 1.35), held 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call after the scene build
shift_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_si.law: the shift press applies the finished run (its ring stays) and starts a NEW operation from offset 0 on all components: a motionless shift click leaves a zero-length ring on the committed ridge (+2 vertices, +1 polygon per edge, nothing moves); a shift drag grows the new ring from 0 (first increment 0.01); with symmetry the new operation re-latches the side at the shift press (press on the -X side: the new rings go inward, +-1.125 -> +-1.0)

middle_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_s.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); mirror symmetry across x = 0 (the click selected both ridges)
middle_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_s.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then middle press at world (-0.5, 1.35), held 1 s, 10 x (+4,+4) px; no scripting call after the scene build
middle_press_after_haul_symmetry_other_s.law: the middle press applies the finished run and starts a NEW operation that immediately re-applies the previous offset: a motionless middle click already extrudes a second ring displaced by the previous offset (ridge 1.125 -> 1.25); a middle drag continues from the previous offset (first increment 0.135, tenth 0.25); with symmetry the re-applied offset takes the side of the middle press at once (press on the -X side: +-1.125 -> +-1.0 before any motion, +-0.875 after the drag)

undo_after_shift_click_after_haul.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
undo_after_shift_click_after_haul.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then one motionless Shift+left click at the same point; then Ctrl+Z three times; no scripting call after the scene build

undo_steps.rows_popped: the second run's adjustment row and its apply row
the first run whole: the activation row, the vertex-map row, its adjustment row and its apply row
the selection click before the tool

undo_after_shift_click_after_haul.law: the modified press opened a NEW operation of the same tool session; the first Ctrl+Z pops that new operation whole (its ring is removed, the committed first run stays) and the tool stays active with the attributes the new operation started from (0 after a shift press, the cloned previous offset after a middle press); the second Ctrl+Z pops the first run together with the tool's activation and the tool ends; the third pops the selection click

undo_after_middle_click_after_haul.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
undo_after_middle_click_after_haul.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then one motionless middle click at the same point; then Ctrl+Z three times; no scripting call after the scene build

undo_after_middle_click_after_haul.law: the modified press opened a NEW operation of the same tool session; the first Ctrl+Z pops that new operation whole (its ring is removed, the committed first run stays) and the tool stays active with the attributes the new operation started from (0 after a shift press, the cloned previous offset after a middle press); the second Ctrl+Z pops the first run together with the tool's activation and the tool ends; the third pops the selection click

undo_after_shift_drag_after_haul.view: front orthographic, pixel size 0.0031056 m; (7,8) selected by a real click at world (1.0, 0.5); no symmetry
undo_after_shift_drag_after_haul.input: activation key; haul h1 = press at world (0.5, 1.35) + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release; then Shift+left press held 1 s + 10 x (+4,+4) px, release at the same point; then Ctrl+Z three times; no scripting call after the scene build

undo_steps.rows_popped: the second run's adjustment row and its apply row
the first run whole: the activation row, the vertex-map row, its adjustment row and its apply row

undo_after_shift_drag_after_haul.law: the modified press opened a NEW operation of the same tool session; the first Ctrl+Z pops that new operation whole (its ring is removed, the committed first run stays) and the tool stays active with the attributes the new operation started from (0 after a shift press, the cloned previous offset after a middle press); the second Ctrl+Z pops the first run together with the tool's activation and the tool ends; the third pops the selection click
